hypothesis: The R108 router had a bypass: its decision head read both memory banks directly, making a learned gate unnecessary. A native tokenless model whose action value MUST pass through a trainable conditional shared/private gate, grounded only in previously observed real chosen-action consequences, will outperform the strongest trained fixed-route and phase-only controls on fresh unfamiliar causal laws while preserving earlier-law recall. Any result is UNIT_ONLY development, not protected scientific acceptance.

mechanism.name: causally-identifiable-output-bottleneck
mechanism.frozen_architecture: Construct public role-bound eight-address shared and context-specific factual memories from 16 real previously chosen action/consequence observations. Train one shared action-value expert applied to both retrieved memories, conditioned only on public role/action/query features. Train an evidence-conditioned sigmoid gate from the observable private-vs-shared evidence disagreement, counts and context; final action-value MUST be gate*private_value + (1-gate)*shared_value. The final value head cannot access both memories except via the gate. Non-gate route has fixed 0,1,0.5 controls and phase-only learned ablation. No private law IDs, hidden changed/unchanged labels, unchosen returns or future query outcomes to memory/router/expert.
mechanism.identification: Check nonzero finite gradient to routing weights on factual FIT query reward. Confirm gate knockout and adversarial factual-feedback swap causally affect predictions using FIT-only records. Report the change in prediction and action selection when the learned gate is replaced by constant 0.5 with network weights held fixed; do not count parameter perturbations or invented truth as learning. Score changed/unchanged regimes only after training and heldout inference.
negative_controls: fresh same-init learned phase/count-only gate with factual evidence removed from gate features but still provided to value experts
fresh same-init feedback shuffled within action and public context
fresh same-init zero observed factual returns
fresh same-init missing public role tags
mechanism.freeze_readback: Strict Git blob identity plus schema/novelty/authority/admission audit before FIT, VALID or UNIT_ONLY source generation
forbidden: No private counterfactual query returns to learner

report_metrics: trained param count and whole-process wall cost
strict Linux/Windows count and pass/fail parity
evaluation.cross_platform: All per-seed correct counts, aggregate subgroup correctness, all frozen criterion outcomes, gate bins, intervention counts and cold-reload mismatches must match exactly. Floating point timing excluded.
